stances.summary: Praises local Democratic coordination and endorsement strategy
stances.quote: I also have to say, I’m very proud of the coordination in Orange County. We’ve collectively built a machine focused on speaking to people year-round. From Rep. Eskamani to the DEC, our local unions, & other electeds, we work together, coordinate, and go all in for our candidates.

stances.summary: Celebrates successful local and statewide Democratic slate performance
stances.quote: I’m proud that our entire local & statewide slate won last night. We work hard to ensure my endorsement isn’t just a co-sign. We dedicated real staff time, knocked doors, raised money, held public events, & did all we could. Proud of the team. Now to the general!

stances.summary: Calls for statewide Democratic organizing and mobilization
stances.quote: This is the ticket! Time to Organize every corner of this state. For a Florida that works for all of us. Let’s get to work. 💪🏾

stances.summary: Celebrates school board victories against Moms for Liberty candidates
stances.quote: SCHOOL BOARD SLATE: WON. GOODBYE MOMS FOR LIBERTY. We knocked doors all summer in these districts.

stances.summary: Endorses Angie Nixon as Democratic U.S. Senate nominee
stances.quote: OUR DEMOCRATIC NOMINEE FOR THE US SENATE! ANGIE NIXON! Let’s get to work, Florida. Let’s win in November.
